typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	  \'HDR\' AS [Record Type] 	 ,\'000000\' + CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) + CAST(? AS CHAR(6))  AS [Control Number] 	 ,\'69009134\' AS [HMO Identifier] 	 ,CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) AS [Creation Date] 	 ,CAST(? AS CHAR(6)) AS [Creation Time] 	 ,SPACE(4537) [Filler1] 	 ,SPACE(4537) [Filler2] 	 ,\'X\' AS [End of Record Indicator]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Creation_Time as string,
		Filler1 as string,
		Control_Number as string,
		Filler2 as string,
		Creation_Date as string,
		Record_Type as string,
		HMO_Identifier as string,
		End_of_Record_Indicator as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Creation_Time = {Creation Time},
		Filler1,
		Control_Number = {Control Number},
		Filler2,
		Creation_Date = {Creation Date},
		Record_Type = {Record Type},
		HMO_Identifier = {HMO Identifier},
		End_of_Record_Indicator = {End of Record Indicator})) ~> FlatFileDestination
